violet-crimson.note: Derived, never pinned; sRGB resolution of the default theme ≈ #a376c0

hero.purpose: The boot screen's one line. 20px, letter-spacing 0.02em.

body.purpose: Prose and titles — what is actually read. 13px/1.55, the base size.

data.purpose: Status lines, code, chips, diffs — what the wall is scanned by. The CJK floor: 12px.

label.purpose: Labels and hints — read once, then recognized. 11px.

mono.purpose: The product's voice for data: branches, paths, kbd, diffs, terminals (13px there, line-height exactly 1).

shadows.name: bevel
shadows.purpose: The machined edge: a one-pixel light on top of anything that sits on the desk. Material, not decoration.

shadows.name: findbar
shadows.purpose: The smallest floater; the terminal find overlay.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: THE BREATH — anything blocked on a human. A 0→2px amber-28% ring over the bevel. The only attention-scale motion.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: THE SHIMMER — a mid-turn card's status edge glows accent↔accent-45%. Weather, never a request.

motion.name: beckon
motion.purpose: The empty board's CTA border drifts toward accent — a hand raised slowly, once.

motion.name: row-move
motion.purpose: Session-row background — the only transition; re-sorting reads as a move, not a flicker.

motion.name: disarm
motion.purpose: Armed buttons auto-disarm when the hand walks away.

themePresets.note: The frontmatter documents the default "ink" preset (= styles.css :root). Five hand-tuned presets exist (ink, paper[light], pine, wisteria, sunset); custom themes take six primaries and derive tiers by sRGB mixing: bg2=2%, bg3=5%, line=11%, fgDim=63%, fgFaint=54% of fg into bg. Semantic hues are load-bearing and survive every preset.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The quiet instrument: Desk Surface fill, seam border, 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; background: var(--bg-3, #221c1f); color: var(--fg, #ebe6e3); border: 1px solid var(--line, #322a2e); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #ebe6e3) 5%, var(--bg-3, #221c1f)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committed jewel as a button: solid ultramarine, dark ink, weight 600.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; background: var(--accent, #6f7dff); color: var(--on-accent, #0d1017); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Outline-tinted, never filled — red is for deletion.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; background: var(--bg-3, #221c1f); color: var(--err, #e26d72); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--err, #e26d72) 35%, var(--bg-3, #221c1f)); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--err, #e26d72) 8%, var(--bg-3, #221c1f)); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Armed Delete
components.description: The two-click grammar, second click: renamed, in the color of consequence, auto-disarms in 4s.
components.css: .ds-confirm-delete { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--err, #e26d72); color: var(--err, #e26d72); font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-confirm-delete:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--err, #e26d72) 8%, var(--bg-3, #221c1f)); } .ds-confirm-delete:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A chip is a chip whatever element carries it; doubles as a small action.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; background: var(--bg-3, #221c1f); color: var(--fg, #ebe6e3); border: 1px solid var(--line, #322a2e); border-radius: 5px; padding: 2px 8px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Fields sit on the deepest surface — the well you type into.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; background: var(--bg, #161214); color: var(--fg, #ebe6e3); border: 1px solid var(--line, #322a2e); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-faint, #90858b); }

components.name: Board Card (needs you)
components.description: The signature: 3px status edge + THE BREATH when blocked on a human.
components.html:
Fix the login redirect loop
等你授權 · waiting on permission
components.css: .ds-board-card { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn, #e0af68) 5%, var(--bg-2, #1b1719)); border: 1px solid var(--line, #322a2e); border-left: 3px solid var(--warn, #e0af68); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 11px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #ebe6e3) 7%, transparent); animation: ds-breathe 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; max-width: 260px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg, #ebe6e3); } .ds-card-state { font-size: 12px; color: var(--warn, #e0af68); font-weight: 600; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #ebe6e3) 7%, transparent), 0 0 0 0 transparent; } 50% { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #ebe6e3) 7%, transparent), 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn, #e0af68) 28%, transparent); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-board-card { animation: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #ebe6e3) 7%, transparent), 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn, #e0af68) 28%, transparent); } }

components.name: Session Row
components.description: Sidebar row: status dot, accent tool name, faint elapsed pushed right.
components.css: .ds-session-row { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; width: 260px; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease; color: var(--fg, #ebe6e3); } .ds-session-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #ebe6e3) 4%, var(--bg-2, #1b1719)); } .ds-session-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #6f7dff); flex: none; } .ds-row-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-title { font-size: 13px; } .ds-row-sub { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-dim, #a69ba0); } .ds-row-tool { color: var(--accent, #6f7dff); } .ds-row-elapsed { margin-left: auto; color: var(--fg-faint, #90858b); }

components.name: Tab (active, unseen)
components.description: Accent underline for active; unread wears a filled pill so it is never the busy dot.
components.css: .ds-tabstrip { display: flex; gap: 1px; background: var(--bg, #161214); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #322a2e); padding: 0 6px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 10px 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg-dim, #a69ba0); background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab.ds-active { color: var(--fg, #ebe6e3); border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #6f7dff); background: var(--bg-2, #1b1719); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #6f7dff); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-tab-badge { background: var(--accent, #6f7dff); color: var(--on-accent, #0d1017); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 5px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Toast (error)
components.description: Bottom-center stack — parallel agents fail in parallel; tinted border, colored text, neutral fill.
components.css: .ds-toast { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang TC', 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; max-width: 70vw; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12px; background: var(--bg-3, #221c1f); color: var(--err, #e26d72); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--err, #e26d72) 35%, var(--bg-3, #221c1f)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #ebe6e3) 7%, transparent), 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); }

narrative.overview:
A warm near-black desk — ink with blood in it, not server-room gray — on which real terminals are laid out like instruments, and one committed jewel of an accent: electric ultramarine at full saturation. The desk stays quiet so the only loud things on it are the agents’ own terminals and the moments a human is actually needed. Color is a language of events, not decoration: a colored edge means something is happening; rest is neutral.

The system is dense, honest, and machined. Dense: 13px body type, 220px sidebar, 5–10px paddings — an operator’s console. Honest: nothing is shown that was not measured; quiet text is a token that still clears AA, never an opacity. Machined: every surface lifts the same way, from the same one-pixel bevel of light, and consequence has a two-click grammar. Components are quiet instruments; consequence is armed.
keyCharacteristics: Eleven theme tokens; every other color is color-mix() over them
Warm near-black three-tier ground with a fixed 2.5% top-light gradient
One saturated accent as focus voice, cursor, and event color — never wallpaper
State speaks through 3px card edges, 7px dot shapes, and two named motions
CJK-aware type floor (12px for anything scanned) and whole-button wrapping
WCAG AA 4.5:1 kept as a floor on every text tier, on the surface it sits on

rules.name: The One Jewel Rule
rules.body: There is one saturated accent and it is spent on attention and motion. A resting surface never wears it; an idle card’s edge is Machined Seam, not blue.

rules.name: The Eleven Tokens Rule
rules.body: No component may introduce a new color. New meanings derive (Violet-Crimson); hovers, tints, and armed states are color-mix() percentages over the tokens: 4–7% resting, 9–12% active, 18–35% selection/borders, 45% peaks.

rules.name: The No-Container-Opacity Rule
rules.body: De-emphasis uses Faintest Honest Ink; opacity on a container drags the buttons and data inside it below AA with it. Cards recede by losing fill and edge, never by fading their text.

rules.name: The Scanned-vs-Read Rule
rules.body: Anything scanned repeatedly sits at 12px or above; 11px is only for things read once and then recognized. Dense CJK decides this floor, not latin.

rules.name: The Whole-Word Rule
rules.body: Buttons wrap as whole buttons, never inside a word — a CJK label broken across lines reads as a different word. Card titles clamp at two lines.

rules.name: The Desk Rule
rules.body: Things lying on the desk are flat: they separate by the three-tier ground ladder and the bevel, and never cast a shadow. Only what floats above the desk carries one.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Pills are literal 999px and stay out of the radius ladder — a pill is a shape, not a rung.

rules.name: The One Loud Motion Rule
rules.body: Anything blocked on a human breathes, and the breath stays loud by being the only attention-scale motion. The shimmer is weather, never a request. Everything settles to honest static states under prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do derive every new color as a color-mix() over the eleven tokens; follow the percentage vocabulary (4–7% resting, 9–12% active, 18–35% selection/borders, 45% peaks).
Do de-emphasize with Faintest Honest Ink (#90858b) — it clears 4.5:1 on every surface tier by construction.
Do reveal hover-hidden actions on :focus-within too — focus landing on an invisible button is the worst of both.
Do keep pointer targets ≥18px square and terminal panes ≥490×350px.
Do arm consequence: two clicks, the button renames itself, rose for deletion, amber for mutation, auto-disarm.
Do give every animation an honest static ending under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write refusals as content that wraps in place, in full — raw errors behind a disclosure, not a tooltip.
Do keep new UI strings in the typed bilingual catalogue (en defines the keys; zh-TW is a total map).
donts: Don't introduce a twelfth color, pin Violet-Crimson to a hex, or hardcode any hex outside the tokens (sanctioned exceptions: the preview iframe's #fff and literal-black shadows).
Don't put opacity on a container to de-emphasize it — it drags everything inside below AA.
Don't give a resting card a colored edge: color on the edge means something is happening. A board of stripes is how state language degrades into decoration.
Don't add a second attention-scale motion; no bounce, no elastic, no cubic-bezier — ease/ease-in-out only.
Don't resize the terminal with chrome, unmount a live terminal, or let a pane fall below the TUI's minimums.
Don't load remote fonts or third-party UI kits; icons are inline one-stroke SVGs at 1em, aria-hidden.
Don't use uppercase letter-spacing outside small section heads, or weight 700 outside pills and tab badges.
Don't show a status you didn't measure: absence of signal wears the no-signal disclaimer; blank and broken must not look alike.
